title: Compose a Panel with Slots
short_description: Practice defining slots in a reusable component and providing their content from the parent.
description: In this challenge, you will complete BasePanel.vue with three regions: a header, main content, and actions.
You will then use those regions from App.vue to build a profile panel without coupling its content to the child component structure.
instructions: In BasePanel.vue, add a header slot with Panel as its fallback title.
Add the default slot inside the content region.
Add an actions slot inside the panel footer.
In App.vue, place the existing Ana's profile title inside #header.
Place the existing Cancel and Save buttons inside #actions.

hints.title: Fallback content
hints.body: Content written inside `<slot name="header">` is displayed when the parent does not provide that slot.

hints.title: Main content
hints.body: The default slot does not need a `name` attribute: you can declare it with `<slot />`

hints.title: Regions from the parent
hints.body: Inside `BasePanel`, use `<template #header>` and `<template #actions>` to provide the named slots.
